description: A console project that references the Windows App SDK fails under dotnet build with a PRI task load error, based on https://github.com/microsoft/WindowsAppSDK/issues/3548.
prompt: I'm experimenting with a tiny .NET console host that opens a WinUI Window, and Visual Studio builds it but `dotnet build` fails. The first error is: `MrtCore.PriGen.targets(913,5): error MSB4062: The "Microsoft.Build.Packaging.Pri.Tasks.ExpandPriContent" task could not be loaded from the assembly C:\Program Files\dotnet\sdk\8.0.206\Microsoft\VisualStudio\v17.0\AppxPackage\Microsoft.Build.Packaging.Pri.Tasks.dll`. What is the project missing?
